title: HTB - Forest
key_techniques: WriteDACL abuse to grant DCSync rights
summary: LDAP null auth exposed all users → AS-REP roasted svc-alfresco → BloodHound WriteDACL chain → DCSync → domain admin

title: HackTheBox - Nibbles
key_techniques: CeWL wordlist generation for targeted admin panel password spray
Sudo NOPASSWD on a user-writable script (monitor.sh)
summary: Enumerated a Nibbleblog v4.0.3 CMS via directory busting, cracked the admin panel with a CeWL-generated wordlist using ffuf, then exploited an authenticated unrestricted file upload to get a shell as nibbler. Escalated to root via a NOPASSWD sudo entry on a user-writable script.

title: HTB - pterodactyl
summary: Unauthenticated RCE via a Pterodactyl Panel path traversal bug (CVE-2025-49132), chained with a PAM allow_active trick and a udisks XFS-resize race for a SUID-root shell.

title: HTB - Sendai
key_techniques: SMB guest access + RID brute force
gMSA hash read via LDAP after ACL abuse
Credential hunting in service ImagePath registry values
ADCS ESC4 template write → ESC1 certificate request
PKINIT with SID extension to retrieve Administrator NTLM
summary: SMB guest → RID brute → blank-password spray → BloodHound ACL chain → gMSA hash → service ImagePath creds → ADCS ESC4 → domain admin

title: Offsec - Coldboxeasy
key_techniques: Authenticated WordPress theme file modification for RCE
Password reuse from database config to lateral movement
SUID binary abuse (find -exec) for privilege escalation
summary: WordPress brute-force → admin panel access → theme file RCE → reverse shell → db credential hunting → password reuse for lateral movement → SUID find privesc to root.
